packageRules.description: Non-major Action bumps: Renovate opens the PR, merging stays with .github/workflows/automerge.yml via the automerge label (PAT path keeps the lovable->dev MERGE / others SQUASH policy). The 7-day wait binds here even though scripts/check-dep-release-age.mjs cannot see it - that gate diffs package-lock, which has no workflow pins.
Major Action bumps need a human decision.
npm: only direct devDependencies may reach the automerge label - this is the equivalent of the dependency-type:direct:development condition dependabot-auto-triage.yml used to apply.
npm majors are human-decided, devDependencies included.
Runtime dependencies never carry the automerge label: they ship to users.
Dev Container image/features: human-reviewed because the typescript-node tag must stay aligned with the node-version used by CI workflows.

Node lives in two places here - the workflow node-version (node datasource) and the Dev Container image tag (docker datasource). Nothing but a shared release makes them agree, so group them: a bump must move both or neither, otherwise CI runs a Node the Codespaces image does not have. Always human-reviewed.
